preconditions.description: The number of stewards n is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in strengths)
preconditions.description: Each steward's strength a_i is between 0 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for a_i in strengths if any(a_j < a_i for a_j in strengths) and any(a_k > a_i for a_k in strengths))
postconditions.description: The number of stewards Jon will support is the count of stewards whose strength has at least one steward with a lesser strength and at least one steward with a greater strength.
